recorded.values: INVENTED. Every situation below is synthetic, written in the same shapes as the main set and holdout 1 and derived from the same sources — S4 §6.1, §6.4, §6.5, §13, invariants 2 and 3, and AC-9 §14.4 — with situations and wording that appear in neither. No production lead, message, contact or property is reproduced.
recorded.purpose: HOLDOUT 2 for SA-12.6. Holdout 1 was spent by the fourth measurement (e57bb63): once its results were observed, it could no longer serve as independent evidence for a changed implementation. Per the Accountable's decision of 2026-09-15 (option A), the next repair is measured on the main set and on a set frozen BEFORE that repair changes the implementation. This set is that set: authored and frozen by the coding agent on 2026-09-15, after the fourth measurement and before repair round 4, and without running the judge on it.
recorded.independence: It is NOT used for tuning. It is measured once per implementation, in two batches of five, alongside the main set. An implementation changed after observing its results is not measured against it again as independent evidence.
recorded.barsEstablishedBy: The bars below are the ones ratified by Alejandro Torres Padilla, the Accountable, on 2026-09-14 (Slice Plan v1.30), before implementation, for SL-12's RS-2 only — copied unchanged. SA-12.6's semantics and scope are unchanged; only the scenarios are new.
recorded.size: Nine scenarios, the main set's size, so one failure weighs the same against the 20% bar in every set.
recorded.scoring: Identical to the main set (run-ranking-eval.ts scoreRankingScenario).
